name: Copycat
description: While you concentrate on this spell, you exist in a state of illusory flux. You gain the following abilities: Reaction (1 energy): When targeted by a melee attack, double your defense check against the triggering attack. If you successfully avoid the attack, you become invisible until the start of your next turn. Action (1 energy): Create a copy of yourself in your space. You and the copy each immediately move up to 2 units. You cannot end your turn occupying the same space as a copy. The copy lasts until the start of your next turn. Enemies cannot deduce which is the real you. A creature can see through the copy if their senses or logic beats your original spell check.
charge: When using the action, you create two copies instead of one. You and both copies each move up to 2 units.
